       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
       ON CONFLICT (user_id, kind, idempotency_key)
       DO UPDATE SET resource_id = create_idempotency_keys.resource_id
       RETURNING resource_id, (xmax = 0) AS "is_inserted!"
